mostWorthwhile.text: Building the epidermal barrier was worthwhile because it showed how outer cells and lipids slow water loss, while deeper cells replace those shed.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to add connective tissue to the barrier was confusing: the need to add blood vessels first was not clear from the pictures.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the connective tissue had to be combined with blood vessels before it could join the barrier.

arbitrary.text: That prerequisite felt a little arbitrary as a game rule. The finished layers made sense, but it was not obvious why I couldn't join them before adding vessels.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the gland and sensory endings made the skin feel like more than just a covering, though I would hope the next chapter makes prerequisites clearer.
